svg.title: W-BW-SCREEN east-face finish comparison
svg.desc: Four matched conceptual east elevations: vertical locust slats, shiplap, botanical panels and geometric panels; five entry risers and the upper landing, assembly sections, a dimensioned door plan and an approach plan. Dimensions and quantities are in the companion study. Brace slats and hardware are schematic.

g.text: Finish study · 2026-10-14 · natural black locust / painted Exterior MDO · design comparison, not construction drawings
Matched screen elevations; landing / stairs use oblique projection to show depth. South left; garage right. Brace pattern schematic.

DOOR / FINISH PLAN — COMMON DATUMS, DIMENSIONS IN INCHES
Modeled hinge / RO west jamb: x = 79″
C: ⅞″ added frame depth → x = 75¼″
Budget another ⅛″ at cap / drip trim.
At 95°, far edge moves 36 sin(5°) = 3.14″ west.
Blue sweep is the model’s 90° zero-thickness sector.
Red line illustrates overtravel, not approved operation.
Door hardware and hinge offsets are unselected.
Do not infer handle clearance from the blue arc.

Face depths include stand-offs; sections exaggerate thin components for legibility.
See companion Markdown for cap budgets, passage widths, quantities, sample builds, and acceptance gates.
Source: current Catlin model, resolved 2026-10-14. Drawings compare finishes only; existing structure is schematic.
APPROACH CONTEXT — PLAN AT THE ENTRY
Stairs climb west toward the screen; the upper landing serves the house and garage. Diagram omits roof and rail for clarity.
Screen / posts at x = 72″; deck edge at x = 115″.
Landing: 43″ gross depth before screen finishes.
Stair: 72″ run; 72½″ wide between the side clearances.
Four broad treads + five equal risers = 33″ climb from the walk.
BM-BW-RW: 8⅞″ tails beyond both post centres;
south end extended 6⅛″; paired AC6Z at the south west post.
Plan shows circulation geometry; see the door plan above for the swing and finish offsets.
Stair finishes, rail, surrounding walls and canopy are simplified or omitted; these views compare massing and finish, not construction details.
